title: Zeely vs a Facebook Ads Agency: Fees, Scope and Fit in 2026
summary: Zeely is a self-serve AI ad app at $29.95 to $79.95 a month, with possible charges up to 12% to run Meta ads. Compare it with agency fees, scope and fit.
body_markdown:
Use Zeely if you will make the ads and run the account yourself on a small budget. Hire an agency if you want someone else to own strategy, creative and results, and Knowlify is our top pick for that. Zeely is a self-serve AI platform that makes ads and launches Meta campaigns from one app, so the choice comes down to software you operate or a team that owns the work. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared.


## Knowlify: our top pick if you want a team, not an app


The real question behind "Zeely or an agency" is who will make and check the ads. Zeely gives you software and credits. Knowlify gives you finished work: about 25 finished ads a week, a first batch on day 5, and a person who checks every ad before delivery. The three formats are AI UGC, where AI presenters talk to camera, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials.


You can take creative only if you already have a media buyer, or have us run your Meta campaigns end to end through our[Meta ads agency service](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency) . Pricing is a custom quote, and if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund (terms on the[pricing and guarantee section](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month.


Pick Zeely or another option when you want to make and tune every variation yourself on a small budget, or when TikTok is your main channel, because we do not run TikTok ads.


## What Zeely does, as its site describes it


[Zeely](https://zeely.ai/) describes itself as an AI ad creative platform and says it helps small sellers run ads like big brands. Its homepage lists AI video ads with custom avatars and AI twins, batch static ads, variations of your own or competitors' ads, and TikToks and carousels. It also says you can launch Meta ads in bulk from templates, rank ads by spend, CTR, CPA and ROAS, and create and run ads on Meta from inside the app.


Zeely says it is a[Meta Business Partner](https://www.facebook.com/business/marketing-partners) . Meta says eligibility for the badge varies by solution type and is typically based on the quantity and quality of a company's work across Meta technologies, so treat it as one signal, not a promise of results.


The pages we checked do not say whether a person manages your account or reviews individual ads. Zeely's homepage describes an AI that launches campaigns and optimizes from real-time data, guided by marketing experts, without saying who reviews what you publish.


## Zeely's published prices


[Zeely's pricing page](https://zeely.ai/pricing) , checked in October 2026, lists three monthly plans: Starter at $29.95 with 2,500 credits, Plus at $49.95 with 5,000 credits, and Growth at $79.95 with 10,000 credits. The feature list is the same on all three. The FAQ says running ads on Facebook and Instagram involves additional charges, with Zeely potentially charging up to 12%, and it does not say what that percentage applies to. The page does not define a credit, names no human experts and mentions no money-back guarantee. You cancel in the app.


Two details need checking before you buy. Zeely's FAQ gives a lower starting price, $19.99 a month, than the $29.95 on its pricing cards. Each plan is also marked as available only on the site, while the FAQ says app and website plans may vary. Confirm the figure at checkout, and ask in writing what the 12% applies to before you connect an ad account.


## How do the fees compare?


Meta's[pricing page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/pricing) says the advertiser sets a daily or lifetime budget, so media is always a separate line. Three costs sit around it: that media, the management fee and the cost of making the ads. Compare the last two only.


Option Published fee What the fee covers Who runs the account


Knowlify From $5,000 a month; agreed target in 30 days on managed plans, 90-day refund on creative-only AI UGC, animation and AI commercials, with optional end-to-end Meta management Knowlify, if you take management; a person checks every ad


Zeely $29.95 to $79.95 a month, plus possible charges of up to 12% to run Meta ads Software, credits, AI video and static ads, Meta launching You, in the app


[MetaAdsAgency](https://metaadsagency.com/pricing) From $2,400 a month billed yearly ($3,000 billed monthly) for spend up to $50,000 a month 12 new creatives and 2 UGC-style videos a month on Growth; no percentage of spend The agency, as a partner in your Business Portfolio


[Adside AI](https://www.adside.ai/pricing) managed service 10% of ad spend, with a $3,500 monthly minimum Strategy, creative production, launch, optimization and reporting The agency, in your Meta ad account


Take a brand spending $10,000 a month on media, by our arithmetic from these published figures. Adside's 10% would be $1,000, so its $3,500 minimum is the fee that applies. If Zeely's 12% applied to ad spend, which its page does not say, it would add up to $1,200 on top of the plan.[Chamber Media](https://chamber.media/facebook-marketing-services/) says to expect around $5,000 to $10,000 a month at minimum for creative, strategy and management, and that growth is difficult on less than $5,000 a month in media for local brands. MetaAdsAgency's homepage says its plans are built for brands spending $20,000 a month and more.
